standard_prerequisites.name: Standard quantum interactive proof/trace-distance tools, SDP complexity and cited space-bounded computation results
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported statements and full original bibliography retained; all local snapshot, parallelization, completeness and complete-problem proofs included.

core_obligations: Construct the SAC1 evaluation protocol and retain BQL simulation.
Parallelize the unitary interactive proof with controlled gap and prove the polynomial-time upper bound.
difficulty_reason: Constructs an interactive protocol for semi-unbounded circuit evaluation and proves a polynomial-time upper bound by uniform turn-halving and weak-gap SDP analysis. The two bounds describe one principal unitary model, preserving strong logspace uniformity, turn count and promise-gap assumptions.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for exclusive DOI without neighbors. Four principal model characterizations counted: high-concentration QIPL, unitary QIPL bounds, constant-turn QIPL, and unitary statistical zero knowledge. Amplification, turn-halving and product-state complete-problem supporting results are uncounted.

locator_notes: Original v3 labels identify targets; high-concentration qualification is essential to NP equality. Constant-message result is QMAML equivalence/NC containment, not an unstated BQL collapse. Full corrected v3 context retained.
